boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Hampden-Sydney College
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food runs in nearby Farmville, each backed by a current destination page showing service at 9:30 p.m. or later on at least one night.

cards.title: The 1 A.M. Drive-Thru
cards.subtitle: 1809 South Main Street, Farmville
cards.notes: Head to South Main Street when other kitchens have closed; confirm holiday hours before making the drive from campus.
cards.short_summary: Farmville’s Wendy’s provides the board’s latest verified restaurant closing time.
cards.evidence_claim: The official Farmville location page lists restaurant and drive-thru hours from 6:30 a.m. to 1 a.m. every day.
cards.access_notes: Official hours show the restaurant and drive-thru open until 1 a.m. daily; holiday hours may vary.

cards.title: The Midnight Taco Bell Run
cards.subtitle: 1708 South Main Street, Farmville
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru for the latest service window, since the listed dine-in closing time is earlier than midnight.
cards.short_summary: A dual-brand counter with a verified midnight drive-thru.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official location page lists drive-thru service from 9 a.m. to midnight seven days a week.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell in Farmville, VA — 1708 S. Main Street
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru hours are listed through midnight daily; the page lists dine-in only through 11 p.m. on Monday, so verify lobby access.

cards.title: The Friday Pizza Pickup
cards.subtitle: 915 South Main Street, Farmville
cards.notes: Order before leaving Hampden-Sydney and select carryout or delivery; Friday and Saturday provide the latest window.
cards.short_summary: A South Main Street pizza counter serving until midnight on weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Hut’s official Farmville page lists service until midnight Friday and Saturday and until 11 p.m. on other nights.
cards.source_title: Take Out Near Me — Farmville, VA — 915 S Main St | Pizza Hut
cards.access_notes: Official hours show delivery and carryout until midnight Friday–Saturday and 11 p.m. Sunday–Thursday; delivery hours may vary.

cards.title: The Downtown Kitchen Stop
cards.subtitle: 127 North Street, downtown Farmville
cards.notes: Choose a table or place a food order downtown; confirm kitchen service separately from the venue’s posted closing time.
cards.short_summary: A downtown restaurant with the latest verified weekend venue hours on the board.
cards.evidence_claim: The restaurant’s official site lists hours until midnight Tuesday–Wednesday and 2 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Main Menu | North Street Press Club Farmville
cards.access_notes: Venue hours run to midnight Tuesday–Wednesday and 2 a.m. Thursday–Saturday; ask the restaurant when food service ends.

cards.title: The 11 P.M. Sit-Down
cards.subtitle: 1808 South Main Street, Farmville
cards.notes: Use dine-in, pickup, or Carside To Go for a later sit-down option; place takeout orders before the posted closing time.
cards.short_summary: A full-service Farmville restaurant with the same verified closing time nightly.
cards.evidence_claim: Applebee’s official Farmville page lists restaurant hours from 11 a.m. to 11 p.m. every day.
cards.source_title: Applebee's Grill + Bar Restaurant in Farmville, VA, 23901
cards.access_notes: The official location page lists dine-in and takeout availability through 11 p.m. Monday–Sunday.

cards.title: The 11 P.M. Chicken Run
cards.subtitle: 2005 South Main Street, Farmville
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru or order online for pickup; submit the order with enough time to arrive before the listed closing.
cards.short_summary: A straightforward South Main Street run with nightly late service.
cards.evidence_claim: KFC’s official Farmville location page lists hours from 10 a.m. to 11 p.m. every day and identifies drive-thru service.
cards.source_title: KFC at 2005 S Main St in Farmville, VA
cards.access_notes: Official hours are 10 a.m.–11 p.m. daily; the location page identifies a drive-thru and online ordering.

cards.title: The Waterfront Dinner Run
cards.subtitle: 201 Mill Street, downtown Farmville
cards.notes: Plan this for Friday or Saturday and request the dining room or deck; call ahead if arriving near the closing time.
cards.short_summary: A named waterfront restaurant with later weekend dining hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The restaurant’s official site lists Friday hours from noon to 10 p.m. and Saturday hours from 11 a.m. to 10 p.m.
cards.source_title: Charley's Waterfront Cafe — Restaurant — Farmville, Virginia
cards.access_notes: Current official hours extend to 10 p.m. Friday–Saturday; closing is 9 p.m. Sunday–Thursday.

cards.title: The 10 P.M. Tex-Mex Stop
cards.subtitle: 119 North Main Street, downtown Farmville
cards.notes: Arrive before the kitchen’s stated cutoff rather than relying on the later venue closing; Monday and Sunday are closed.
cards.short_summary: A downtown Tex-Mex destination with an explicitly documented kitchen cutoff.
cards.evidence_claim: one19’s official site lists venue hours until 10 p.m. Tuesday–Saturday and states that the kitchen closes at 9 p.m.
cards.access_notes: The venue is listed open until 10 p.m. Tuesday–Saturday, but its kitchen closes at 9 p.m.; food orders must precede that cutoff.

cards.title: The 9:30 P.M. Pizza Run
cards.subtitle: 404 South Main Street, Farmville
cards.notes: Save this run for Friday or Saturday, and place the order at least 30 minutes before closing as the restaurant directs.
cards.short_summary: An independent pizza stop with a clearly stated weekend ordering cutoff.
cards.evidence_claim: Pino’s official hours page lists Friday and Saturday service until 9:30 p.m. and an order cutoff 30 minutes before closing.
cards.access_notes: Friday–Saturday hours end at 9:30 p.m.; the restaurant states that ordering stops 30 minutes before closing.

cards.title: The All-Night Wawa Run
cards.subtitle: 2582 Farmville Road, Farmville
cards.notes: Use this all-night option for prepared food or packaged snacks, and check the route before leaving the Hampden-Sydney area.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour convenience-food counter on Farmville Road.
cards.evidence_claim: The destination listing for Wawa Store 6611 identifies the Farmville Road address, built-to-order food, and 24-hour daily operation.
cards.source_title: Wawa in Farmville, VA | Apple Maps
cards.access_notes: The current place listing shows the store open 24 hours every day; prepared-food counter availability may differ overnight.

warnings: Late-night means service at 9:30 p.m. or later on at least one night; several destinations have earlier kitchen, lobby, or ordering cutoffs than their venue closing time.
North Street Press Club and one19 serve alcohol but also operate as food restaurants; the cards recommend food service only and do not rely on alcohol-related access.
Wawa hours are supported by a current Apple Maps place page because its direct business-location page could not be retrieved.
